messages:
maria: Quick idea — propose a lightweight 'SI Skillboard' that captures: lab completions, HW integrations validated, marketplace listing readiness, and a micro-cert badge. Goal: faster approvals for joint marketplace listings. Thoughts?
ben: Love it. makes the gating explicit. can the Skillboard be a single-page dashboard in the partner portal? :eyes:
li: Agree. We should avoid a heavy process. Minimum: 3 lab passes, 1 integration demo, signed SOW template. Badge auto-granted after checks.
sam: How do we handle lab access? provisioning is the blocker for most SIs.
provision-bot: FYI — current sandbox quotas: 5 concurrent SI labs, default TTL 72h. To request more: run `./scripts/provision_lab.sh --si <name> --hours 168 --env=sandbox` and ping infra.
alex: Can we templatize the lab tasks? e.g. HW partner board: attach test harness + checklist. That way certification reviewers have a checklist to check off.
tess: Micro-cert idea: two tiers — 'Integration Ready' (pass automated labs + quick live demo) and 'Marketplace Ready' (plus docs, legal checklist, support matrix). Badges = %-style SVG for partner pages.
maria: Nice. timeline q: if we aim to include first 3 SIs in marketplace beta, when should we start running labs?
ben: If we start provisioning next week and run 2-week windows, beta list by Nov 8 is doable. Need PM to own outreach.
li: I'll own outreach and schedule. Also propose a short FAQ + cheat sheet for SIs to reduce back-and-forth.
sam: For validation, propose: 1) automated smoke tests, 2) a recorded 10-min demo, 3) one integration issue fixed. Keep it light.
alex: For announcements, coordinate with marketing; prefer a soft launch (partner page live) and a joint webinar later. 
tess: Need legal ok on badge phrasing. I'll loop in legal tomorrow.
maria: OK — action items: li = outreach + schedule; ben = dashboard mockup; alex = lab task templates; tess = legal badge copy; li/maria = coordinate infra quota increase if needed. I'll create a follow-up thread with assignment links. :thumbsup:
provision-bot: Quota request template: `team:partnerships, si_name:<name>, requested_concurrent:10, duration_days:14, purpose:skillboard-beta` — send to infra-requests.
maria: Thanks all — will post follow-ups.
